turns.user_input: Load the player values data from data/player_values.json. Calculate the trade value for each player using the formula: production_score * age_multiplier * contract_value_factor. Rank them from highest to lowest.
Proposed trade: Team A (Chicago) sends Zach LaVine and an unprotected 1st round pick for Team B (New York's) OG Anunoby. Is this a fair trade based on the value model?
What if Chicago offers a top-5 protected 1st round pick instead of unprotected? Recalculate the trade values.
Find the most lopsided trades possible where one team gets 2x the value. Show the top 3 most unbalanced but salary-matchable trades (within 125% of each other's salary for trade rules).
Generate a trade board: top 10 most tradeable players and their value, considering both trade value score and likelihood of being moved (expiring contracts, rebuilding teams, bad fits).
